$comment: Single source of the Rule 13 journey-marker patterns (CLAUDE.md). `pattern` flags journey PROSE (comments, test titles, doc text; applied case-insensitively). `namePattern` flags journey tokens in DURABLE NAMES (exported identifiers, file/directory names, Nx target names); it is applied to the kebab-normalized form of a name — camelCase boundaries become '-', every non-alphanumeric run becomes '-', then lowercased — so word boundaries hold (`handleAuthV2` normalizes to `handle-auth-v2` and matches; `renewal`, `stepId`, `newValue`, `uuidv4` never match). `new`/`old`/`temp` are flagged only as the trailing segment (a `utils-new` sibling), because leading forms legitimately describe end-state behavior (`NewWorkflowModal` creates a new workflow, `tempDir` holds genuinely temporary files). Consumers: shared/tools/eslint-local-rules/no-journey-markers.mjs, shared/tools/eslint-local-rules/no-journey-marker-names.mjs, shared/tools/dev-cli/src/check-journey-markers.mjs.
